statement: let ψ := fun x : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n; let θ := fun x : ℝ => ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log (p : ℝ); ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → 0 ≤ ψ x - θ x ∧ ψ x - θ x ≤ Real.log 4 * Real.sqrt x + 2 * x ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log x

plain_statement.en: For every real x ≥ 2, the Chebyshev prime-power difference ψ(x) - θ(x) is nonnegative and at most (log 4) √x + 2 x^(1/3) log x.
plain_statement.zh: 对任意实数 x ≥ 2，切比雪夫素数幂差 ψ(x) − θ(x) 非负且至多为 (log 4)√x + 2 x^(1/3) log x。

brief.en: Decompose the non-prime support of Λ(n) into prime powers p^k (k ≥ 2) using PEqualNP.Outside.L_goldbach_mangoldt_power_support, bound θ(x^(1/2)) via primorial ≤ 4^n (Rosser–Schoenfeld 1962), and bound each higher k ≥ 3 term uniformly by θ(x^(1/3)) ≤ (log 4) x^(1/3).
brief.zh: 利用已证模块 PEqualNP.Outside.L_goldbach_mangoldt_power_support 将 Λ−素数权 拆为高次素数幂 p^k (k ≥ 2)，借助素数阶乘 ∏_{p≤n} p ≤ 4^n 控制 θ(√x)，并用 θ(x^(1/3)) 统一控制 k ≥ 3 的所有高次幂之和。
